description: Clash-rate control for the rigid AIM placement, C-terminal tail geometry in the AlphaFold model, and propeptide length across reviewed fungal ATG8 proteins
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os
from collections import defaultdict
os.makedirs("out",exist_ok=True)
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def parse_pdb(txt):
    at=[]
    for ln in txt.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith("ATOM"):
            at.append(dict(name=ln[12:16].strip(),res=ln[17:20].strip(),chain=ln[21],seq=int(ln[22:26]),
                           x=float(ln[30:38]),y=float(ln[38:46]),z=float(ln[46:54]),b=float(ln[60:66]),
                           el=(ln[76:78].strip() or ln[12:16].strip()[0])))
        elif ln.startswith("ENDMDL"): break
    return at
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    Dm=np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))]);R=Vt.T@Dm@U.T
    return R,qc-R@pc

z=parse_pdb(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/2ZPN.pdb",timeout=90).text)
meta=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q8WZY7",timeout=60).json()[0]
af=parse_pdb(requests.get(meta["pdbUrl"],timeout=90).text)
plddt={a['seq']:a['b'] for a in af if a['name']=='CA'}

def place_and_score(target_atoms, ref_chain='A', pep_chain='E'):
    """Superpose target onto 2ZPN ref_chain CAs, bring the AIM peptide into target frame, score."""
    ref=[a for a in z if a['chain']==ref_chain]
    pep=np.array([[a['x'],a['y'],a['z']] for a in z if a['chain']==pep_chain])
    caR={a['seq']:np.array([a['x'],a['y'],a['z']]) for a in ref if a['name']=='CA'}
    caT={a['seq']:np.array([a['x'],a['y'],a['z']]) for a in target_atoms if a['name']=='CA'}
    com=sorted(set(caR)&set(caT))
    P=np.array([caT[i] for i in com]); Q=np.array([caR[i] for i in com])
    R,t=kabsch(P,Q); rms=np.sqrt((((R@P.T).T+t-Q)**2).sum(1).mean())
    pin=(R.T@pep.T).T + (-R.T@t)
    heavy=[a for a in target_atoms if a['el']!='H']
    AC=np.array([[a['x'],a['y'],a['z']] for a in heavy])
    D=np.sqrt(((AC[:,None]-pin[None])**2).sum(-1)); md=D.min(0)
    return dict(n_ca=len(com), rmsd=round(rms,2), clashes=int((md<2.2).sum()),
                contacts=int((md<4.5).sum()), n_pep=len(pep), closest=round(md.min(),2)), D, heavy

print("=== CONTROL: the same rigid-placement pipeline applied to the three other Atg8 copies in 2ZPN ===")
rows=[]
for ch,label in [('B','2ZPN:B yeast Atg8 (crystallographic control)'),
                 ('C','2ZPN:C yeast Atg8 (crystallographic control)'),
                 ('D','2ZPN:D yeast Atg8 (crystallographic control)')]:
    s,_,_=place_and_score([a for a in z if a['chain']==ch]); s['model']=label; rows.append(s)
s_apg,Dapg,heavy=place_and_score(af); s_apg['model']='AF-Q8WZY7 APG-6 (test)'; rows.append(s_apg)
ctrl=pd.DataFrame(rows)[['model','n_ca','rmsd','n_pep','contacts','clashes','closest']]
print(ctrl.to_string(index=False))
ctrl.to_csv("out/apg6_AIM_placement_controls.csv",index=False)
mean_ctrl=np.mean([r['clashes'] for r in rows[:3]])
print(f"\nAPG-6 clash count {s_apg['clashes']} vs crystallographic-control mean {mean_ctrl:.1f} "
      f"-> rigid placement of an unrelaxed peptide produces this many minor overlaps even between genuine Atg8 copies.")

# which APG-6 atoms clash, and are they rotatable side chains?
md_atom=Dapg.min(1)
cl=[(heavy[i]['seq'],AA3.get(heavy[i]['res'],'X'),heavy[i]['name'],round(md_atom[i],2))
    for i in np.where(md_atom<2.2)[0]]
print("\nAPG-6 atoms within 2.2 A of the rigid-placed AIM:")
for c in sorted(cl,key=lambda x:x[3]): print(f"   {c[1]}{c[0]} {c[2]:4s}  {c[3]} A  "
    f"{'side chain (rotatable)' if c[2] not in ('N','CA','C','O') else 'MAIN CHAIN'}")

# ---- C-terminal tail: extended and solvent-facing? ----
ca={a['seq']:np.array([a['x'],a['y'],a['z']]) for a in af if a['name']=='CA'}
cent=np.mean([ca[i] for i in range(1,112)],axis=0)
d_cent={i:np.linalg.norm(ca[i]-cent) for i in ca}
core_d=np.mean([d_cent[i] for i in range(1,112)])
print(f"\nC-terminal geometry in the AlphaFold model (distance of CA from the centroid of residues 1-111):")
print(f"  mean over core 1-111: {core_d:.1f} A")
for i in range(111,122): print(f"  {AA3[[a for a in af if a['seq']==i and a['name']=='CA'][0]['res']]}{i}: {d_cent[i]:.1f} A  (pLDDT {plddt[i]:.0f})")

# ---- comparative fungal ATG8 C-termini ----
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
    params={"query":'(family:"ATG8 family") AND (taxonomy_id:4751) AND (reviewed:true)',
            "fields":"accession,id,organism_name,sequence,length","format":"tsv","size":60},timeout=90)
rows=[l.split("\t") for l in r.text.strip().split("\n")]
fdf=pd.DataFrame(rows[1:],columns=rows[0])
print(f"\n=== Reviewed fungal ATG8-family entries in UniProt: n={len(fdf)} ===")
recs=[]
for _,x in fdf.iterrows():
    s=x['Sequence']; L=len(s)
    gi=s.rfind('G')
    # find the canonical cleavage Gly: last G that is followed by <=10 residues and preceded by F at -1
    cand=[i for i in range(len(s)) if s[i]=='G' and (len(s)-1-i)<=12]
    g=None
    for i in cand:
        if i>=2 and s[i-1] in 'FYWLV': g=i
    if g is None and cand: g=cand[0]
    recs.append(dict(entry=x['Entry'], name=x['Entry Name'], organism=x['Organism'][:38], length=L,
                     cleav_Gly=g+1 if g is not None else None,
                     context=s[max(0,g-6):g+1] if g is not None else "",
                     extension=s[g+1:] if g is not None else "", ext_len=L-(g+1) if g is not None else None))
cdf=pd.DataFrame(recs).sort_values("organism")
print(cdf.to_string(index=False))
cdf.to_csv("out/fungal_atg8_C_termini.csv",index=False)
print("\nExtension-length distribution among reviewed fungal ATG8s:")
print(cdf.ext_len.value_counts().sort_index().to_string())
print("APG-6 (Q8WZY7) extension length:", cdf.loc[cdf.entry=="Q8WZY7","ext_len"].values)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.4))
ax=axes[0]
ax.bar(ctrl.model.str.replace(" \\(","\n(",regex=True),ctrl.clashes,color=["#9aa6b2"]*3+["#2b4c7e"])
ax.set_ylabel("rigid-placement clashes (<2.2 A)")
ax.set_title("AIM placement clash control\nAPG-6 is within the range seen between genuine Atg8 copies",fontsize=10)
ax.tick_params(axis='x',labelsize=7)
ax=axes[1]
ax.hist(cdf.ext_len.dropna().astype(int),bins=np.arange(-0.5,13.5,1),color="#1f6f4a",edgecolor="white")
ex=int(cdf.loc[cdf.entry=="Q8WZY7","ext_len"].values[0])
ax.axvline(ex,color="#c0392b",lw=2)
ax.text(ex+0.15,ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.85,f"APG-6 = {ex}",color="#c0392b",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("residues C-terminal to the cleavage glycine"); ax.set_ylabel("reviewed fungal ATG8 entries")
ax.set_title("Propeptide length across reviewed fungal ATG8 proteins",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
